raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. hutan: a ~ fire, kebakaran hutan; a pine ~, hutan pain; virgin ~, hutan dara; 2. ( fig. ), ( of vertical objects ) berceracak, berceranggah: a ~ of hands, tangan-tangan yg berceracak; a ~ of ships’ masts, tiang-tiang kapal yg berceranggah; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
